record.question: The train _______ before we reach the station.
record.explanation: Answer A: will have left. The future perfect “will have left” describes the train’s departure before the future time “we reach the station” (A). Independent check: The future-perfect verb phrase marks a departure completed before the future time “we reach.” Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/idiom; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses.
